summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, announcing a 1-for-5 reverse stock split of its Class A ordinary shares, effective August 6, 2026. Approved by the board and majority shareholders on July 23, 2026, the split reduces outstanding shares from ~7.1 million to ~1.4 million. No fractional shares issued; rounded up. Trading continues under ticker SUGP with new CUSIP G8552M141. Transfer agent Transhare Corporation manages the exchange. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation, likely intended to meet Nasdaq listing requirements.
